name: Martial Weapon
text: Effective melee weapons — swords, staffs, tridents. While using one, gain +1 Damage (not cumulative with other weapons).

name: Ranged Weapon
text: Any projectile weapon — bows, boomerangs, energy guns. Grants +1 Attack (not cumulative). Has Close range (attacks at other distances have Disadvantage); increase range to Far for 5 PAX.

name: Kryptonite (Special Material)
text: Your weapon contains the mineral anathema to Kryptonians. (Ranged: tracked via the Ammunition Die.)

name: Nth Metal (Special Material)
text: Thanagarian metal that negates gravity; a weapon made from it grants Flight Grade 1 to its wielder.

name: Promethium (Special Material)
text: Earth's strongest alloy; Promethium weapons ignore an amount of the target's Damage Reduction equal to the wielder's Tier.

name: Smoke Bombs
text: Spend 1 Use: for 1 Round, all targets within a Close Zone of the impact suffer -3 on rolls requiring sight.

name: Grappling Gun
text: Spend 1 Use to move 1 Distance in any direction. Pull and Strike: spend 1 Use for a ranged attack at Close/Far that pulls the target 1 Distance toward you (dealing Damage if it ends Adjacent).

name: Healing Spray
text: Spend 1 Use to remove the Scratched or Tired Condition from an Adjacent target.

name: Tracker
text: Spend 1 Use to place a tracker on a person or object; it emits a GPS signal indicating the target's location.

name: Rebreather
text: Spend 1 Use: until the end of the Scene, breathe normally in aquatic environments.

name: Alteration Mask
text: Spend 1 Use: until the end of the Scene, alter your face.

name: E.M.P.
text: Spend 1 Use: non-military electronics within Close are disabled for a Scene; robotic/tech-armored enemies make a Resistance Test (Tension 16) or lose tech abilities for 1 Round.

name: Adhesive Bomb
text: Spend 1 Use vs a target up to Close: they make an Agility Test (Tension 15) or gain Immobilized.

name: Personal Hologram
text: Spend 1 Use to project a decoy at Close range. Until your next turn, an enemy attacking you must pass a Mind Test (Tension 14) or attack the hologram and lose the Action.

name: Cryptographic Sequencer
text: Spend 1 Use before a test to hack a system, disable an electronic lock, or decipher a coded message: gain Advantage on that test.

name: Sleep Gas
text: Spend 1 Use: all targets within Close (except you) make a Resistance Test (Tension 14) or gain Asleep for 1 Round or until they take damage.
